第八章男主是真的有靠山

顾城转身就走，好像一切都在他的掌握。就算开头替他妈说了句道歉，其实谁都能看出他一点也不在意孩子没了，更不在意闫嫣的死活。

“畜生啊，当初怎么就眼瞎到选了个牲口。”

闫奶奶再次呼天抢地，就差坐顾家祖坟前骂十八代了。

闫嫣拉着奶奶的手，她不是原主，并不伤心。只有害她受罪的恨，为原主的不值，更有对原主的怒其不争。

“奶，别气。现在看清顾城的冷血解脱出来其实是好事，不然说不定哪天我死在顾家你们都不知道。”

“可不是，幸好幸好。只是我不明白顾城不喜欢你为什么要娶，嫌你挡了路为什么不提前就把路空出来，娶进门再折磨图啥？”

“哼，图啥，图他不是人，图他不在意别人的生死。”

这是闫嫣唯一能找出的答案了。

“嫣嫣好好养身体，爷爷去交代几件要办的事。”

“爷爷，顾城绝不简单，我想既然撕破脸不如先下手为强。”

“你想怎么做？”

“堵他的路，盯死他，无论他接触谁都先一步往上一级部门检举。只要有人敢为他出头，那就承担一切被告的下场。

可能咱没什么权利，但也没人把闫家人的嘴给堵死，他找人压咱们就闹，要闹到压不下去，要闹到他如过街老鼠。”

“好，爷爷找人办。”

闫爷爷拍拍孙女瘦的只剩骨头的胳膊，叹口气出门，真希望她永远没长大。

“老四，你来一下。”

闫和平正在院子里劈柴，既然穿来了就要学着好好生活，原主懒，他却不能懒，不然媳妇闺女吃啥。

“爸。”

“你现在去找你之前的狐朋狗友，给我把顾城盯紧了，无论他去哪里和谁见面都要记清楚。”

“明白，我手里什么不多就朋友多。”

闫爷爷狠狠送出去一巴掌，把闫和平后脑巴要给拍碎，龇牙咧嘴像极了原主的模样。

“这是一百块钱，给我把事办好了，别再像以前不着调，闫嫣往后还要靠你生活。”

“爸，你放心。往后我绝对好好干活，绝对能撑起家。”

Chapter 8 The male protagonist really has a backer

Gu Cheng turned around and left, as if everything was under his control.Even though he apologized for his mother at the beginning, everyone could see that he didn't care at all about the child's death, let alone Yan Yan's life or death.

"Beast, how could you be blind enough to choose an animal in the first place?"

Grandma Yan once again screamed at the heavens and the earth, so she just sat in front of the Gu family's ancestral grave and scolded the eighteenth generation.

Yan Yan held her grandma's hand. She was not the original owner and was not sad.The only hatred that caused her to suffer was the unworthiness of the original owner, and even more anger towards the original owner.

"Nai, don't be angry. It's actually a good thing to be freed from Gu Cheng's cold blood now. Otherwise, you might not even know I die in the Gu family one day."

"No, it's lucky. It's just that I don't understand why Gu Cheng didn't like you and why he wanted to marry you. Why didn't he clear the way in advance if he thought you were blocking the road? What's the point of torture after getting married?"

"Humph, what are you trying to do? He's not a human being, he doesn't care about other people's life or death."

This is the only answer Yan Yan can find.

"Yanyan, please take good care of yourself. Grandpa will go and tell you a few things that need to be done."

"Grandpa, Gu Cheng is not simple at all. I think since we are breaking up, it is better to strike first."

"What do you want to do?"

"Block his way, keep an eye on him, and no matter who he comes into contact with, report it to the higher-level department first. As long as someone dares to stand up for him, he will bear the consequences of all the defendants.

Maybe we don’t have any rights, but no one has blocked the Yan family’s mouth. If he finds someone to suppress us, he will make trouble until we can no longer suppress him, or until he is like a rat crossing the street."

"Okay, grandpa will find someone to do it."

Grandpa Yan patted his granddaughter's arm, which was so thin that only bones were left, sighed and went out. He really hoped that she would never grow up.

"Fourth, come here."

Yan Heping was chopping firewood in the yard. Since he came here, he had to learn to live a good life. The original owner was lazy, but he couldn't be lazy, otherwise his wife and daughter would have nothing to eat.

"Dad."

"Now go find your former friend and keep an eye on Gu Cheng. No matter where he goes and who he meets, you must remember it clearly."

"Understand, I don't have many things in my hands, but I have many friends."

Grandpa Yan slapped Yan Heping so hard that the back of Yan Heping's head was shattered, and he grinned like the original owner.

"Here's one hundred yuan. Please get things done for me and stop being careless like before. Yan Yan will have to rely on you for her life in the future."

"Dad, don't worry. I will definitely work hard in the future and I will definitely be able to support the family."
